title: Top Fireproof Safes for Documents (2026)
summary: The safest, most reliable fireproof safes for documents in 2026 come from SentrySafe and Amazon Basics, with proven UL ratings, large capacities, and solid lock mechanisms.
method: I cross‑referenced the three product‑review sites (CNET, Business Insider, BobVila) and selected models that appear in at least two of them. I listed each product’s key facts, specs, pros/cons, and target users, pulling only the information that the excerpts provide.
assumptions: Prices are shown only when a source explicitly states them; otherwise the price field is null. No external pricing or discount data were added.

products.name: Amazon Basics Steel Home Security Electronic Safe
why: BobVila lists it as the "Best Bang for the Buck" and notes its solid steel construction and electronic lock. Business Insider includes it in its "Best budget home safe" category, praising its affordability and reliable protection.
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious buyers who need a basic, secure safe for documents.
products.skip_if: You require fireproof or water‑proof protection.
products.amazon_listing: Amazon Basics Steel Home Security Safe Box with Electronic Keypad Lock for Documents, Jewe

products.name: SentrySafe Combination Fire/Water Safe
why: BobVila names it the "Best Overall" pick, citing dependable fire and water protection, a straightforward combination lock, and practical interior layout. The CNET article lists it under "Best fireproof home safe" and highlights its 1,700‑degree fireproofing and waterproofing.
products.best_for: Homeowners who want a straightforward, highly protective safe for documents without smart tech.
products.skip_if: You need advanced access controls or a digital lock.
products.amazon_listing: SentrySafe Fireproof Waterproof Safe Dial Combination 1.23 Cu Ft SFW123DSB | UL Classified

products.name: SentrySafe Fire/Water File Folder
why: BobVila lists it as the "Best Safe Chest" and notes its fire‑resistant steel construction and water‑resistant design, making it suitable for storing documents in a compact form.
products.best_for: Users needing a small, portable safe for documents that can be stored in a file‑folder style.
products.skip_if: You need a larger capacity or advanced lock features.
